name: Pettenderly
why_review: Pettenderly helps cat and dog owners create downloadable AI pet portraits from one to five photos of the same pet. It offers watercolor, royal, studio and window-seat styles, with paid credits and no credit charged for failed generations. It is a focused image-generation tool that readers can try for personal portraits and digital keepsakes. Generated details can vary.
special: A pet-focused workflow with one to five reference photos, several portrait styles and digital downloads. Pricing starts at $4.99 for 12 credits. No free generation plan or physical printing is offered.
